components.name: Format Segmented Control
components.description: Primary action: the release format picker; red marks the active ratio, common screen shapes sit after a dashed divider.
components.css: .ds-seg { display: flex; height: 36px; border: 1px solid var(--hair-strong, rgba(233,231,225,.32)); background: var(--bg, #0c0d0f); font: 500 14px/1.4 var(--font-ui, 'Schibsted Grotesk Variable', system-ui, sans-serif); } .ds-seg__opt { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; padding: 0 10px; border: 0; border-left: 1px solid var(--hair-strong, rgba(233,231,225,.32)); background: none; color: var(--ink-dim, rgba(233,231,225,.66)); font: inherit; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 160ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1), color 160ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-seg__opt:first-child { border-left: 0; } .ds-seg__opt--group { margin-left: 8px; border-left: 1px dashed var(--hair-strong, rgba(233,231,225,.32)); } .ds-seg__opt:hover { color: var(--ink, #e9e7e1); background: var(--hair, rgba(233,231,225,.16)); } .ds-seg__opt:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--blue, #3aa0ff); outline-offset: -2px; } .ds-seg__opt[aria-checked='true'] { background: var(--red, #d9302c); color: #fff; font-weight: 700; } .ds-measure { font-family: var(--font-measure, 'Martian Mono', ui-monospace, monospace); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; font-size: 12px; opacity: .85; }

components.name: Ink Segmented Control
components.description: Lenses, scaling and other non-ratio choices; selection is an ink fill, never red.
components.css: .ds-lenses { display: inline-grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(4, auto); border: 1px solid var(--hair-strong, rgba(233,231,225,.32)); background: var(--bg, #0c0d0f); } .ds-lens { min-height: 34px; padding: 4px 12px; border: 0; border-left: 1px solid var(--hair, rgba(233,231,225,.16)); background: none; color: var(--ink, #e9e7e1); font: 600 12px/1.15 var(--font-ui, 'Schibsted Grotesk Variable', system-ui, sans-serif); cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 160ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1), color 160ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-lens:first-child { border-left: 0; } .ds-lens:hover { background: var(--hair, rgba(233,231,225,.16)); } .ds-lens:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--blue, #3aa0ff); outline-offset: -2px; } .ds-lens[aria-pressed='true'] { background: var(--ink, #e9e7e1); color: var(--bg, #0c0d0f); }

components.css: .ds-btn-outline { min-height: 34px; padding: 4px 12px; border: 1px solid var(--ink, #e9e7e1); border-radius: 0; background: var(--bg, #0c0d0f); color: var(--ink, #e9e7e1); font: 600 14px/1.4 var(--font-ui, 'Schibsted Grotesk Variable', system-ui, sans-serif); cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 160ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1), color 160ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-btn-outline:hover { background: var(--ink, #e9e7e1); color: var(--bg, #0c0d0f); } .ds-btn-outline:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--blue, #3aa0ff); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-outline:disabled { border-color: var(--hair-strong, rgba(233,231,225,.32)); color: var(--ink-dim, rgba(233,231,225,.66)); cursor: not-allowed; }

components.name: Trailer Field
components.description: Square input joined to its button as one bordered strip; red border when invalid.
components.css: .ds-field { display: flex; font: 400 12px/1.4 var(--font-ui, 'Schibsted Grotesk Variable', system-ui, sans-serif); } .ds-input { width: 260px; height: 32px; padding: 0 12px; border: 1px solid var(--hair-strong, rgba(233,231,225,.32)); border-radius: 0; background: var(--bg, #0c0d0f); color: var(--ink, #e9e7e1); font: inherit; caret-color: var(--red, #d9302c); } .ds-input::placeholder { color: var(--ink-faint, rgba(233,231,225,.42)); } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--blue, #3aa0ff); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-input[aria-invalid='true'] { border-color: var(--red, #d9302c); } .ds-input-btn { height: 32px; padding: 0 12px; border: 1px solid var(--hair-strong, rgba(233,231,225,.32)); border-left: 0; background: var(--bg, #0c0d0f); color: var(--ink, #e9e7e1); font: 600 12px/1.4 inherit; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 160ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-input-btn:hover { background: var(--hair, rgba(233,231,225,.16)); }

components.css: .ds-tabs { display: flex; height: 52px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--hair, rgba(233,231,225,.16)); background: var(--bg, #0c0d0f); font: 500 14px/1.4 var(--font-ui, 'Schibsted Grotesk Variable', system-ui, sans-serif); } .ds-tab { position: relative; display: flex; align-items: center; padding: 0 16px; color: var(--ink-dim, rgba(233,231,225,.66)); text-decoration: none; transition: color 160ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-tab:hover { color: var(--ink, #e9e7e1); } .ds-tab:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--blue, #3aa0ff); outline-offset: -2px; } .ds-tab[aria-current='page'] { color: var(--ink, #e9e7e1); font-weight: 700; } .ds-tab[aria-current='page']::after { content: ''; position: absolute; left: 16px; right: 16px; bottom: -1px; height: 2px; background: var(--ink, #e9e7e1); }

components.css: .ds-rank { width: 320px; border-collapse: collapse; background: var(--bg, #0c0d0f); color: var(--ink, #e9e7e1); font: 400 12px/1.4 var(--font-ui, 'Schibsted Grotesk Variable', system-ui, sans-serif); } .ds-rank__row { border-bottom: 1px solid var(--hair, rgba(233,231,225,.16)); } .ds-rank__row td { padding: 8px 4px; } .ds-rank__n, .ds-rank__s { text-align: right; font-family: var(--font-measure, 'Martian Mono', ui-monospace, monospace); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-rank__n { width: 30px; color: var(--ink-dim, rgba(233,231,225,.66)); padding-right: 8px; } .ds-rank__dev { font-weight: 600; } .ds-rank__s { width: 58px; } .ds-rank__bar { display: block; height: 2px; margin-top: 4px; background: var(--hair, rgba(233,231,225,.16)); } .ds-rank__bar span { display: block; height: 100%; background: var(--blue, #3aa0ff); } .ds-rank__row--first { background: var(--red-wash, rgba(217,48,44,.09)); } .ds-rank__row--first .ds-rank__n { color: var(--red, #d9302c); font-weight: 500; box-shadow: inset 3px 0 0 var(--red, #d9302c); }

components.name: Framing Chart Glass
components.description: Signature: device glass under the registration grid, active red frame with corner ticks and tag, blue frame for another ratio, centre crosshair.
components.html:
1.90
1.43 IMAX
components.css: .ds-stage { display: grid; place-items: center; width: 420px; height: 280px; background: radial-gradient(ellipse at center, transparent 45%, #0c0d0f 100%), linear-gradient(rgba(233,231,225,.16) 1px, transparent 1px) center / 80px 80px, linear-gradient(90deg, rgba(233,231,225,.16) 1px, transparent 1px) center / 80px 80px, #0c0d0f; } .ds-dev { padding: 10px; background: var(--bezel, #17181b); border: 1px solid var(--hair-strong, rgba(233,231,225,.32)); border-radius: 22px; } .ds-glass { position: relative; width: 300px; height: 210px; overflow: hidden; background: #000; border-radius: 12px; } .ds-red, .ds-blue { position: absolute; } .ds-red { z-index: 3; box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1.5px var(--red, #d9302c); transition: all 520ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-blue { z-index: 2; box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px var(--blue, #3aa0ff); } .ds-tick { position: absolute; left: 0; bottom: 0; width: 10px; height: 10px; background: linear-gradient(#d9302c,#d9302c) bottom left / 10px 3px no-repeat, linear-gradient(#d9302c,#d9302c) bottom left / 3px 10px no-repeat; } .ds-tag { position: absolute; padding: 4px 8px; font: 500 11px/1.2 var(--font-measure, 'Martian Mono', ui-monospace, monospace); letter-spacing: .08em; text-transform: uppercase; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-tag--red { top: 0; left: 0; background: var(--red, #d9302c); color: #fff; } .ds-tag--blue { top: 0; right: 0; background: var(--bg, #0c0d0f); border: 1px solid var(--blue, #3aa0ff); color: var(--blue, #3aa0ff); } .ds-cross-h, .ds-cross-v, .ds-ring { position: absolute; left: 50%; top: 50%; transform: translate(-50%,-50%); z-index: 4; } .ds-cross-h { width: 36%; height: 1px; background: rgba(233,231,225,.32); } .ds-cross-v { height: 36%; width: 1px; background: rgba(233,231,225,.32); } .ds-ring { height: 24%; aspect-ratio: 1; border: 1px solid rgba(233,231,225,.32); border-radius: 50%; }

narrative.overview:
The whole app is one framing chart, the kind a projectionist tapes up to line a picture up with a screen. A near-black ground carries a faint registration grid. Every release ratio is drawn on it as a labelled frame line, and the device's own glass sits under those lines. The active ratio is the one red line on the chart. Every other ratio is a blue hairline. The chart is a working instrument, not a showroom. It refuses the usual category look of glossy device mockups on a dark spec page.

The density is like an instrument panel. There is one reading size (14px), and hierarchy comes from weight, position and the switch from grotesk to mono, not from big type. Structure comes from 1px rules, not fills or shadows. Measurements, ratios and frame tags are set in mono, stencilled in small caps, so a number always reads as a measurement. Controls have square corners. Devices keep their real corner radii, because that radius is a measured fact about the device.

Motion has one job: when the format changes, the red frame line and the picture box glide to the new ratio over 520ms on a long ease-out, and the blue lines stay where they are. UI feedback is a fast 160ms colour change. Reduced motion turns both off.
keyCharacteristics: Near-black chart ground with a faint 80px registration grid and a vignette on the stage.
Red is the active ratio and nothing else. Blue draws every other ratio and every score bar.
1px hairline rules carry all structure. There are no drop shadows.
Schibsted Grotesk for UI. Martian Mono only for measurements, ratios and stencilled labels.
Square controls. Devices keep their real radii.
One signature motion: the red frame line moves, everything else holds still.

rules.name: The One Red Rule
rules.body: Red marks the active ratio and nothing else (rank 1 and the verdict box are the active ratio's winner, so they count as the same signal). The only exception is the error border on an invalid input. Every other selected state, such as lenses, orientation, scaling and view tabs, uses an ink fill or ink underline, never red.

rules.name: The Blue Is Everything Else Rule
rules.body: Non-active frame lines, score bars, links and focus all use Frame Blue. Blue never marks a selection.

rules.name: The Mono Means Measured Rule
rules.body: Martian Mono appears only on measurements, ratios, stencilled field names and frame tags. Prose and controls never use it.

rules.name: The One Reading Size Rule
rules.body: Hierarchy comes from weight and position on a 14px base. Nothing above 24px exists.

rules.name: The Drawn Not Lifted Rule
rules.body: If something needs emphasis, draw a line around it or inside it. Don't lift it with a shadow.

dos: Do give red only to the active ratio and its rank-1 result, and use ink fills for every other selected state.
Do draw every non-active ratio, score bar, link underline and focus ring in Frame Blue (#3aa0ff).
Do set every measurement, ratio and frame tag in Martian Mono with tabular figures, and keep prose and controls in Schibsted Grotesk.
Do build structure from 1px hairlines (16% / 32% chart-white) and square corners.
Do keep devices at their real measured corner radii.
Do animate frame changes on the 520ms frame timing with `cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1)`, and UI feedback at 160ms.
donts: Don't use red for lenses, tabs, orientation, scaling or any state other than the active ratio.
Don't add drop shadows. Inset strokes for frame lines and the rank marker are the only shadow use.
Don't round controls, tags or panels.
Don't set prose or button text in the mono face.
Don't go above 24px type or add a separate display face.
